focusedTests.source: Three included Desktop/settings test files, copied into the isolated installed package and run against its shipped runtime

privacy.note: Pattern checks are not an exhaustive secret scanner; files were exported only from runtime source, selected tests and public project documentation.

limitations: Not a clean-machine or recipient-machine end-to-end Desktop test.
No automatic message sent to a live chat during packaging.
New unattended prompt behavior across a future quota reset remains unverified.
Compatibility depends on Codex Desktop local app-tools protocol.
